finding: With no credentials on 2026-09-29, twelve days after the last such pass, every measured answer on Statsig's product surfaces is unchanged: the MCP initialize answers 401 with the same 138-byte body and the same Bearer challenge naming its RFC 9728 resource metadata; the Console API GET answers 401 Unauthorized; both OAuth metadata documents answer 200 with the same fields, including the device-code grant that made this server unusual among those this reporter has measured; openid-configuration is still 404; the product MCP overview still lists 67 tools in 11 categories with an identical name set. An empty cell stays empty: no client was registered, no token obtained and no account made, so the device-code grant is advertised and not exercised, and whether the free Developer plan can reach the 27 review-workflow tools is still not measured.
